title: Approved detailed CAD becomes the canonical training URDF
summary: The user approved the full-range 18-joint animation and designated the motor-weight-corrected detailed URDF as ground truth for all future training. Its mass is7.466088235kg; pitch zeros are preserved, per-leg yaw limits retain a continuous0.5mm standoff gap, and source geometry/inertias are preserved with explicit nominal motor corrections. The default viewer and contributor guidance now use the detailed robot; native admission remains pending.
next: Use the canonical detailed model for a new runtime contract and native SDF/contact/actuator admission before further training. Preserve historical simplified and four-bar task/checkpoint identities; no new training on those assets.
